notes: The day map is colour-graded for display. The clouds are a multi-day composite (2002 MODIS), not a real day.
Equirectangular, longitude -180 to 180 left to right, latitude 90 to -90 top to bottom (GIBS EPSG:4326 WMS).

files.processing: 8192x4096 source colour-graded for display (saturation x1.2; ocean pixels with b > 1.4 r pulled 45% toward [0.07, 0.17, 0.42]), then Lanczos downsampled to 4096x2048. Display grading, not data.
files.credit: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation and Black Marble via NASA GIBS
NASA Blue Marble Next Generation and Black Marble via NASA GIBS

files.processing: Water (mean > 0.42 in the OSM land/water map) = 170, land = 255, bilinear to 2048x1024. Used as a roughness map.
files.credit: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation and Black Marble via NASA GIBS

files.processing: Cloud map bicubic to 4096x2048, blur 0.6 px, black point 0.08, gamma 1.15; alpha reduced by 85% over ice found in the graded day map. A multi-day composite, not a real day.
files.credit: NASA Earth Observatory Blue Marble cloud map (2002 MODIS composite)

files.processing: Tone map 1 - exp(-k x), k = 1.5 / p99.95, gamma 1/2.2, background below 0.10 pulled to black, **1.3, area-averaged 2x down to 4096x2048. Display tone mapping.
Re-encoded, no pixel changes. A daily image, so the fetch time is the image date.

disc.method: pixels brighter than 0.06 of full scale (sky is 0), centroid and sqrt(area / pi), in fractions of image width; v from the top
